# Official MusicXML 4.0 examples

These unmodified files come from the MusicXML example set:

https://www.musicxml.com/music-in-musicxml/example-set/

- `Chant.musicxml`
- `MozartTrio.musicxml`
- `MozaChloSample.musicxml`

The files were retrieved on 2026-07-26. `MozaChloSample.musicxml` is encoded as
UTF-16BE with a byte-order mark; the other two files are UTF-8.

The following documents reproduce the examples from the MusicXML 4.0 Opus
reference:

https://www.w3.org/2021/06/musicxml40/opus-reference/examples/

- `OpusLink.musicxml`
- `OpusScore.musicxml`
